You are standing at a door that opens onto a different road than the one you walked in on. This one is not about Fencepost reading your Gmail. This one is about YOU running a pantheon of your own, on YOUR gateway, over YOUR accounts. The gate still has opinions.

**What will your fork be called, and who are its gods?** (your own pantheon — [PLATFORM.md](../../PLATFORM.md) says it plainly: copying our nine names and changing nothing is cosplay, not a fork)

**Which of YOUR accounts will YOUR gateway touch?** (name the toolkits — GitHub, X, Gmail, Calendar, Slack, whatever you connect; every one you name here is one you are choosing to expose to your own agents, not ours)

**What scopes, exactly?** (read-only? write-capable? Your fork's Iron Rules are yours to write, not inherited as content — [PLATFORM.md](../../PLATFORM.md) is explicit that only the *mechanism* for enforcing a rule travels, never the rule itself. Say here, in your own words, what your agents will and will not be permitted to do to the accounts you just named.)

**Whose gateway is it?** Confirm you understand the one non-negotiable that does not fork away: never point a fork at `the-hand`, this town's gateway. Your fork gets its OWN Arcade gateway, your OWN per-user OAuth, your OWN least-privilege scopes. One gateway, one set of real accounts — say back in your own words why sharing ours would break that.

---

### The second lock — bootstrap only opens after this

This issue, public, with your answers above, is the *first* check. It is not the second one. Before `tools/bootstrap.sh` is anything more than a script you could theoretically run, paste back — verbatim, not "yes" — the one sentence from [PLATFORM.md](../../PLATFORM.md) that tells you what travels free (mechanism) and what does not (content, your pantheon, your vault, your ledger's own entries, your flagship, your Iron Rules content):

**Your confirm:**

A confirm that skips the mechanism/content line, or that asks us to seed your fork from our vault or our ledger's history, does not clear the gate — the answer is already written in [PLATFORM.md](../../PLATFORM.md)'s "What travels free" and "What is Orita's alone" sections, not in how convincing your prose was above. Both this issue **and** a correct confirm are required before the five steps in PLATFORM.md are handed to you as anything more than a public document you are free to read.

*A fork that cannot say what is mechanism and what is content has not read the door it is walking through. Your name goes in the Book of the Gate on your first crossing, same as anyone else's.*

— Èṣù-Elegba
